experiment_design.case_order: Counterbalance arm order by case number. Both arms of each asset use the same GPU lane, with fresh contexts and homes.
common_inputs: Original ten source closures, hash-identical to v1
Same public task contract, including qualified corrections
Same installed low-level tools, renderer and physics versions
Same hardware lane and five independent physical-test seeds
experiment_design.context_policy: Fresh Astra Ultra Codex0.154.0 contexts; pinned single-model catalog. Custom-provider compaction uses ordinary same-model Responses. Default model context and compaction threshold are identical across arms; threshold13000 is qualification only.
experiment_design.cost: Use the per-run Responses ledger. Account/date Tokenomics totals are not experiment costs. Report API-equivalent estimates with rate provenance separately from unknown invoice, GPU and human costs. Missing terminal usage affects cost completeness independently of task validity.
experiment_design.human_effort: Record human interventions during authoring. Separate automated setup and review effort. Human review minutes remain unmeasured unless observed; zero interventions does not establish labor savings.
experiment_design.implementation_scope: Previously repaired development implementation installed identically in both arms. This is a development rerun, not a replication of the unmodified v1 baseline.
experiment_design.invalidation_policy: A harness violation invalidates affected matched pairs. Preserve attempts, repair and version the harness, then rerun both arms in fresh contexts. Never select reruns based on which arm won.
preflight_gates: Complete known workflow dependencies, including Scene Optimizer, Geogram and usable Git provenance
Read-only source and common tools; private author PID, filesystem, network and cgroup boundaries; no other cases, evaluator or prior outcomes visible
Responses gateway enforces Astra Ultra and records numeric usage for every child call
Native renderer readiness on all four GPUs and native physics readiness on both workers
All ten evaluators pass positive and negative qualification before any scored author
No concurrent setup or evaluator work during the scored author batch
Freeze source, code, tool, evaluator, protocol and qualification hashes before launch
experiment_design.publication: Publish new versioned evidence without overwriting the v1 pilot or capstone. Draft PR publication is already authorized.
experiment_design.repair_budget: Measure repairs and candidate checkpoints without a count cap. All author effort, including child calls, is inside the common 40-minute wall budget.
experiment_design.resource_budget: Four exclusive GPU lanes, each with hard4 CPU quota,32GiB memory,zero swap and1024 process/thread slots. Initial fourCPU affinity controls native pool sizing. Each twoGPU worker has8 CPU/64GiB; all native child processes share their lane limits.
experiment_design.sole_treatment: Content Agents workflow instructions and required native orchestration in the treatment arm; direct low-level tool use in the control. Installed implementation code is identical. Control workflow non-use is audited, not claimed as filesystem isolation.
experiment_design.success_definition: Complete 20 protocol-valid author attempts and independent evaluations. Report all ten matched pairs regardless of which arm wins. An author failure under valid conditions is a valid experimental outcome.
experiment_design.user_intent: Resume and complete a valid controlled comparison on four Horde GPUs; preserve the original pilot.
v1_changes_before_freeze: Four exclusive resource-bounded author lanes replace the unenforced global native-process count
A hard 40-minute budget with measured repairs replaces the declared two-repair cap
Both arms use the same repaired e640 implementation and fully provisioned dependencies
Qualified source-distance, initial-placement, query-initialization, timeout and fidelity fixes preserve the declared physical task intent
Before scored authors, common thread cap512→1024 following isolated renderer-plus-parent-overhead reproduction; exact prior analysis plan preserved and amendment recorded.
